characters.name: Lillekort
characters.prompt: A brave, small-statured Norwegian boy from the 1400s–1850s. He wears simple, slightly tattered clothing and carries a magical sword. He has bright eyes, a determined expression, and an air of youthful confidence.

characters.name: Kong Lavring
characters.prompt: The older twin brother of Lillekort, nearly identical in appearance. Tall for the era, wearing old Norwegian garments with subtle regal touches. He carries himself with composure and fortitude.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A dignified Norwegian king dressed in dark, fur-trimmed robes from the 1400s–1850s. He has a stately crown and a worried expression, reflecting the burden of protecting his daughters.

characters.name: The Youngest Princess
characters.prompt: A gentle, graceful princess wearing a simple yet elegant gown in soft tones. She has a caring expression and a regal bearing typical of Norwegian royalty in the 1400s–1850s.

characters.name: The Oldest Princess
characters.prompt: A poised Norwegian princess with a more formal demeanor. She wears a slightly grander gown with intricate embroidery and has a confident, resolute gaze.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.prompt: A tall, imposing knight dressed in ornate plate armor with crimson details. He exudes arrogance and ambition, holding himself with pomp and self-importance.

characters.name: The Trolls
characters.prompt: Gigantic, menacing Norwegian trolls with multiple heads (5, 10, or 15), rough, mossy skin, and large iron clubs. They loom over the land, emanating an otherworldly aura.

characters.name: Old One-Eyed Hags
characters.prompt: Bent and ancient figures with a single eye, wrapped in ragged cloaks. They appear crafty and mysterious, offering magical artifacts in exchange for their stolen eyes.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a grand Norwegian landscape of the 1400s–1850s: dense evergreen forests, a wooden royal hall, and a flowing river. Show Lillekort, small but determined, wielding a gleaming magical sword, facing off against a towering multi-headed troll. The King and Princesses watch anxiously in the background. Overall, maintain a dark yet hopeful fairy-tale atmosphere rooted in old Norwegian folklore.
modernMainImagePrompt: Visualize this tale in a present-day setting: a modern Norwegian cityscape with towering glass buildings next to fjords. Lillekort, now a small-statured teenager in casual streetwear, boldly confronts a large, graffiti-covered mechanical troll. The Princesses wear contemporary fashion with subtle royal flair. The mood balances modern adventure with echoes of timeless folklore.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a cheerful, storybook-style image set in old Norway, appropriate for a 5-year-old. Show a friendly-looking Lillekort in bright, simple clothing standing before a big, funny troll. Include a rainbow in the sky, cute forest animals, and a cozy wooden cottage. Keep colors vibrant and the scene gentle, emphasizing the happy, magical nature of the story.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Tegn en norsk skogscene med en liten, modig gutt som heter Lillekort foran et stort troll. Prinsessen og kongen står ved ei enkel trehytte i bakgrunnen. Motivene skal være tydelige og oversiktlige, med et varmt lys fra solnedgangen over fjellet. Designet skal være enkelt og anvendelig for moderne bildebøker.
englishMainImagePrompt: Show a grand fairy-tale forest in old Norway (1400s–1850s), with Lillekort, a diminutive hero in worn attire, poised to battle a towering troll with multiple heads. The King and Princesses look on from a rustic castle in the background. Use rich, painterly details to reflect the original Norwegian folklore mood and setting.
